Looking for a hands-on job with car parts from top brands like Audi, BMW and Volkswagen? As a warehouse employee, you’ll process and check orders, store parts with care and keep the warehouse running smoothly. You work from 10:00 to 18:00 in a friendly, close-knit team. Earn €14.99 per hour, plus travel allowance, good pension and more benefits. Ready to grow your career in the automotive world? Apply now! 🚀

Employment agency Manpower is looking for a warehouse worker for a client in Nunspeet.

As a warehouse employee, you will work with a wide range of car parts from top brands such as Audi, BMW and Volkswagen. Think of bumpers, roofs, trunk lids, windshields and mirrors. How cool is it to be surrounded by high-quality parts from the automotive world every day? Many of these parts are surprisingly light, and handy tools are available for the heavier items. This allows you to work efficiently and without heavy loads! Some of your tasks include:

    - Receiving, checking and storing incoming goods
    
- Order picking, packaging and shipping of products
    
- Ensuring an organised and efficient warehouse

What’s in it for you

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer
    
- Full-time position of 40 hours per week
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Free access to E-learning platform Manpower Academy 
    
- Temporary contract through Manpower

    - At least a high school diploma
    
- Experience in a similar role
    
- Available of 40 hours per week
    
- Good command of the Dutch or English language, both spoken and written, due to the nature of the work

Are you the warehouse worker we're looking for? Apply today and Manpower will contact you within two working days!

Are you looking for a flexible job that fits perfectly into your life? Become an Uber Eats delivery courier!

Decide when you work, cycle through the city, and earn money while doing it. With Uber Eats, you enjoy the freedom to work on your own terms. 

What are you going to do?
As a courier for Uber Eats, you’ll be the link between restaurants and hungry customers.

Your main tasks are:

- Picking up meals from local restaurants
- Navigating the fastest route using the Uber Eats app
- Delivering with a smile and punctuality – keeping customers happy and well-fed

What do we offer?
- Salary: Starting at €16,19 gross/hour (age 21+), including holiday pay

Where will you work?
Join Uber Eats and become part of a global leader in food delivery that offers flexible work opportunities, competitive earnings, and the freedom to choose your own schedule. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time work, Uber Eats provides a simple way to earn while delivering food and connecting communities. and flexibility. Our shared goal is for all our deliveries to be emission-free by 2040.

Be part of a movement that’s changing the way the world eats.

What do we ask?
To start as a delivery courier with Uber Eats, you must meet the following conditions:

•            You are at least 16 years old

•            You live in the Netherlands

•            You speak either Dutch or English

•            You have a smartphone with an internet connection

•            You have your own bicycle, e-bike, or scooter

*Please note: delivery using a car, e-step (electric scooter), or any other vehicle is not allowed

Hey, happy face! You always know how to put a smile on someone’s face. That's why you are the perfect driver for Albert Heijn Amsterdam! You have a lot of freedom and your own work van. You also earn a salary of € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks! KATSJINGGG! Are you curious about this position? Then read on and discover how you can apply!

What we offer
- Bring a friend and get € 200!
- Earn € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks!
- Travel allowance
- Flexible working hours
- Full-time, and part-time options
- A fun and friendly team!

Who you are
As a driver for Albert Heijn, you look forward to drive around on the streets of Amsterdam. You are also able to lift heavy crates. What else is important to know about this job:
